summary: Chrono-Bio Outpost is an interactive browser-based mission simulator built for junior astronauts ages 7–12 to experience the real engineering trade-offs of running a lunar or Martian habitat. Unlike traditional space games that use abstract scorebars, our trainer connects life support, power budgeting, hydroponic food production, and radiation shielding into a living, visual cross-section of an off-world base. Players navigate 7 simulated mission sols while managing real NASA space weather events, such as coronal mass ejections, and experiencing authentic Earth-to-Mars communication delays. Every decision carries a real consequence: diverting power to thicken water-wall radiation shields slows down oxygen-producing algae bioreactors, forcing young commanders to think like real NASA flight controllers. By turning complex aerospace constraints into tangible cause-and-effect gameplay, Chrono-Bio Outpost inspires the next generation of explorers with accurate space science.
details:
Chrono-Bio Outpost places students ages 7–12 in command of a 4-person lunar or Martian habitat across a 7-day (7-Sol) mission. Players manage four interconnected systems:

  • Power Grid: Generated by solar arrays that fluctuate based on dust clouds and mission windows.
  • Hydroponic Algae Bio-Lab: Consumes power to convert CO2 into breathable oxygen and astronaut food rations.
  • Water-Wall Radiation Shielding: Pumps habitat water reserves into roof bladders to absorb solar radiation during flare alerts.
  • Comms Delay Simulator: On Mars mode, commands experience a simulated signal delay, teaching young commanders predictive mission planning instead of panic-clicking.

Benefits & Intended Impact
Space-themed STEM tools often oversimplify survival or overwhelm young learners with complex equations. Our trainer bridges this gap by translating real NASA Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) trade-offs into visual cause-and-effect gameplay. Kids learn critical thinking, resource conservation, and how astronauts survive beyond Earth's magnetic field.

Creativity & Design Considerations

  • Zero-Sum Engineering Trade-Offs: Every action has a real cost. Pumping water to thicken roof radiation shields reduces available life-support water and oxygen reserves, while running astrobiology science samples drains battery power and oxygen.
  • Visual Feedback Over Jargon: Rather than complex data tables, habitat pods visually react—pod borders flash red during critical shortages, solar arrays dim when power drops, and a kid-friendly Flight Director Science Log explains the real NASA science behind every event.

Tools, Languages & Software Used

  • Frontend & Simulation Engine: HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript (built with zero heavy dependencies so it runs smoothly on school Chromebooks, tablets, and low-bandwidth browsers).
  • Scientific Reference Data: NASA DONKI space weather flare parameters, NASA ECLSS closed-loop life-support ratios, and NASA SRAG radiation shielding principles.

SI Disclosure: Portions of the simulation code and mission scenario text were developed with the assistance of an AI language model and reviewed by Team MVY#brothers.

<script>
let state = {
planet: 'Moon',
sol: 1,
o2: 80,
power: 75,
shield: 60,
score: 0,
gameOver: false
};

const nasaEvents = [
{ name: "NASA DONKI Alert: X-Class Solar Flare!", effect: { shield: -30, power: -10 }, tip: "Real NASA Fact: Solar flares send high-energy protons across space. Water walls block radiation!" },
{ name: "Regolith Dust Cloud Passing Over Arrays", effect: { power: -25, o2: -5 }, tip: "Real NASA Fact: Lunar and Martian dust reduces solar panel efficiency by up to 40%." },
{ name: "Crew EVA (Spacewalk) Airlock Cycling", effect: { o2: -20, power: -10 }, tip: "Real NASA Fact: Every time astronauts exit the airlock, precious cabin oxygen and pump power are spent." },
{ name: "Algae Bioreactor Bloom Surge!", effect: { o2: +10, power: -15 }, tip: "Real NASA Fact: Microalgae converts astronaut CO2 back into breathable oxygen using LED grow lights." },
{ name: "Micrometeorite & Cosmic Ray Spike", effect: { shield: -20, o2: -10 }, tip: "Real NASA Fact: Without Earth's magnetic field, deep-space cosmic rays constantly test habitat shielding." },
{ name: "Peak Noon Solar Window", effect: { power: +15, shield: -10 }, tip: "Real NASA Fact: High noon gives maximum solar power, but UV and thermal radiation also peak." }
];

function setPlanet(p) {
state.planet = p;
document.getElementById('btn-moon').className = p === 'Moon' ? 'active-mode' : '';
document.getElementById('btn-mars').className = p === 'Mars' ? 'active-mode' : '';
resetGame();
}

function sendCommand(type) {
if (state.gameOver) return;
const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.cmd-btn');
btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = true);

const delay = state.planet === 'Mars' ? 2200 : 400;
if (state.planet === 'Mars') {
document.getElementById('delay-indicator').style.display = 'inline-block';
}

setTimeout(() => {
document.getElementById('delay-indicator').style.display = 'none';
executeTurn(type);
if (!state.gameOver) btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = false);
}, delay);
}

function executeTurn(type) {
let actionMsg = "";
if (type === 'algae') {
state.o2 += 20; state.power -= 15;
actionMsg = "Boosted LED grow lights: Algae produced fresh O2 & food, draining battery reserves.";
} else if (type === 'shield') {
state.shield += 25; state.o2 -= 15;
actionMsg = "Pumped life-support water into roof bladders: Radiation shielding increased!";
} else if (type === 'solar') {
state.power += 25; state.o2 -= 10;
actionMsg = "Crew suited up to brush dust off solar panels: Power restored, extra oxygen used.";
} else if (type === 'science') {
state.score += 100; state.power -= 15; state.o2 -= 10;
actionMsg = "Analyzed core soil samples for NASA! Earned 100 Science Points.";
}

const ev = nasaEvents[Math.floor(Math.random() * nasaEvents.length)];
state.o2 += (ev.effect.o2 || 0);
state.power += (ev.effect.power || 0);
state.shield += (ev.effect.shield || 0);

state.o2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, state.o2));
state.power = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, state.power));
state.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, state.shield));

logMessage(`[Sol ${state.sol}] ${actionMsg}`);
logMessage(`⚠️ EVENT: ${ev.name} — ${ev.tip}`);

if (state.o2 <= 0 || state.power <= 0 || state.shield <= 0) {
state.gameOver = true;
document.getElementById('event-text').innerHTML = `🚨 <strong>MISSION ABORTED ON SOL ${state.sol}!</strong> A critical life-support system hit 0%. Real astronauts rely on balanced trade-offs. Click Restart to try again!`;
updateUI();
return;
}

if (state.sol >= 7) {
state.gameOver = true;
state.score += (state.o2 + state.power + state.shield) * 5;
document.getElementById('event-text').innerHTML = `🏆 <strong>MISSION ACCOMPLISHED!</strong> You safely commanded the ${state.planet} outpost for 7 Sols! Final NASA Science Score: <strong>${state.score}</strong>.`;
updateUI();
return;
}

state.sol++;

Use code with caution.

document.getElementById('event-text').innerText = Sol ${state.sol} underway on ${state.planet}. Latest Hazard: ${ev.name}. Choose your next engineering trade-off!;
updateUI();
}

function updateUI() {
document.getElementById('sol-num').innerText = state.sol;
document.getElementById('score').innerText = state.score;
document.getElementById('val-o2').innerText = state.o2;
document.getElementById('val-power').innerText = state.power;
document.getElementById('val-shield').innerText = state.shield;

document.getElementById('bar-o2').style.width = state.o2 + '%';
document.getElementById('bar-power').style.width = state.power + '%';
document.getElementById('bar-shield').style.width = state.shield + '%';

document.getElementById('pod-bio').style.border = state.o2 < 30 ? '2px solid var(--danger)' : '1px solid #334155';
document.getElementById('bio-status').innerText = state.o2 < 30 ? '⚠️ Low Oxygen!' : 'Photosynthesis Active';
document.getElementById('pod-power').style.opacity = state.power < 30 ? '0.6' : '1';
document.getElementById('shield-status').innerText = state.shield < 30 ? '☢️ High Radiation!' : 'Shielding Nominal';
}

function logMessage(msg) {
const log = document.getElementById('mission-log');
log.innerHTML = <div>• ${msg}</div> + log.innerHTML;
}

function resetGame() {
state = { planet: state.planet, sol: 1, o2: 80, power: 75, shield: 60, score: 0, gameOver: false };
document.querySelectorAll('.cmd-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = false);
document.getElementById('mission-log').innerHTML = <div>• [Sol 1] ${state.planet} Outpost initialized using NASA ECLSS closed-loop ratios.</div>;
document.getElementById('event-text').innerText = Welcome, Commander! Keep Oxygen, Power, and Radiation Safety above 0% for 7 Sols on ${state.planet}.;
updateUI();
}
